title: The app crashes immediately upon minimizing, even for just a second.
body:
I followed your advice to refresh the app via Settings > Keep > Background App Refresh, but the crashing issue persists. Many other iOS users have reported the same problem on platforms like Reddit and Google communities.

Interestingly, the previous app version was stable even when minimized, but immediately after updating, the crashing resumed every time I minimize the app—even briefly.

Please prioritize resolving this issue, as it’s driving many users away.

I would like to make a recommendation:
The date of creation of notes should be included, not just the date of last edit. Because this feature isn't available, I have to include the date at the beginning of each note whenever I type. Sometimes, due to the urgency of the moment, I forget. Including this feature will help a lot.

title: Creation date and modification date!
body:
I like the app because of its cloud based storage that gives me access to my notes across all my devices regardless if it is an iphone or not. But the problem i have with keep is that it doesn’t keep the date of the creation of each note which is very bad and almost destroys the reason of having to note down an event or occurrence. It only show the date the note is edited. Please it would be a-lot better if the creation date is added to the information of each note, that way we can be accurate and know when we created our note even if it was tampered with by someone else unauthorizedly. Please treat this as urgent 🙏

Looking forward to getting a better version of the google keep.
